segments.en: Hello.
Where are you from?
I am from Trivandrum. Where are you?
This is Kollam.
Okay, what do you do?
I used to do work for Oottu, but I am not doing anything now.
Okay, you are awake, right? You don't have sleep at night?
Morning, now it is... this I did yesterday morning... sorry, yesterday night I was awake.
Is that so?
What is the reason for not sleeping?
I need some money in the morning.
Is that so?
Yes.
Is there any...
I am sitting for that.
There is, OpenTalk is there, it is on WhatsApp, it is a paid service.
Why is it like that?
From this, we get 5 rupees for one minute.
So, there is nothing for us to do for free.
You are getting it, right?
If you are getting it in this, it is your choice.
I just said, if I do it, I usually do it on WhatsApp.
Because of safety issues, it is scary.
Okay.
Bye bye, look for something else.
